target: STM32F446RE (env nucleo_f446re) + APS6404L PSRAM over SPI2
method: Static RAM: arm-none-eabi-nm -S on firmware.elf, broken down with gdb 'ptype /o' on a -g build of the same source (same 92,828 B). Heap: the new[]/new/reserve calls reached from the firmware, sizes from sizeof() in gdb. PSRAM: the region map in PSRAM_controller.hpp. Sizes are in bytes. 'children' break an object down; any leftover is listed as 'other fields'.

notes: Static RAM is 70.8% of the 128 KB (was 83.2% before the quick wins of notes/performance-and-memory.md: 109,088 B -> 92,828 B, -16,260 B). The heap (~17.5 KB, mostly the list row cache) and the stack share the ~37 KB left, so the stack has ~20 KB (was ~4.4 KB).

Stack depth is now measured on the device: app/stack_probe.cpp paints the free RAM at boot, and the [prof] line ('stackFree'/'stackMax') and the bench 'stats' answer (stack_free_min / stack_used_max) report the high-water mark. Not yet run on hardware for this file.
One SdFat for the whole card (MusicLookup::sd, 1,180 B with its 512 B sector cache): Audio_buffer takes a reference to it.
The debug serial keeps 256 B RX + 1,024 B TX (SERIAL_RX/TX_BUFFER_SIZE in platformio.ini); the Bluetooth UART has its own driver (bluetooth/BtUart.h) with 256 B RX + 64 B TX.
